SR-001.justification: With ipc.unix_sockets on the workspace and no network, the caged child binds, listens and connects in the workspace, while connecting to a daemon socket outside and opening TCP fail, on macOS (EPERM) and Linux T1 (masked daemon ECONNREFUSED, TCP EPERM).

SR-002.justification: On T1 the host abstract socket gives ECONNREFUSED (separate network namespace); on T2 below ABI 9 the setting is refused naming ipc-unix-sockets, in the canary and in the lowering test.

SR-003.justification: On T2 the hidden file is unreadable directly and through a symbolic-link sibling and a listing is denied while a sibling reads; an entry created after the spawn is denied; a write rule around is refused at preparation and a write grant around fails the spawn naming both; the secrets class keeps a home's .ssh unreadable while reading /. The negative control shows the test fails without the expansion.

SR-004.justification: accept_spawn_snapshot holds exactly the five SPAWN_SNAPSHOT constructs; without it the secrets and fs-hide approximations are refused with a message naming the option; with it they lower and appear in the degradations; a glob rule stays refused.
